title: photinia parvifolia var. chingshuiensis
intro: Photinia parvifolia var. chingshuiensis, commonly known as Ching-Shui or Taiwan Photinia, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ching-Shui are believed to be attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
